note: Official spec uses param name {id}, ours uses {taskId}. Both resolve to the same concrete path. Probe uses our path (functionally identical).

request.rationale: Spring-MVC discrimination: 405 = path registered for PUT only; 404 Spring-MVC = path absent

response.spring_mvc_signal: 405 Method Not Allowed — path IS registered in the router, accepts PUT but not GET

param_name_discrepancy.resolution: Same path segment, different descriptor name. Not a functional difference.

notes: GET to .../tasks/{taskId}/cost-rate returns 405 (Spring-MVC confirms path registered for PUT). Both official and our spec document this path. The {id} vs {taskId} param name difference is cosmetic — same concrete path. Full LIVE-VERIFIED requires a live PUT call (done in companion probe file).
